categories.main_business_segments: Shengtak New Materials Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the production, research, and sales of industrial seamless steel pipes for energy equipment, including power station boilers and petroleum refining industries. It also operates in automotive parts manufacturing through its subsidiary Jiangsu Ruimei, focusing on lightweight and electric vehicle components. Additionally, the company produces welded steel grating and related products mainly for energy and petrochemical sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced metallurgical technologies to produce high-grade alloy steel pipes such as T91, T92, TP347H, and Super304H stainless steel pipes, meeting stringent high-temperature and high-pressure requirements for supercritical and ultra-supercritical boilers. It employs order-driven production with flexible procurement and outsourcing for standardized processes. R&D focuses on developing new high-performance steel grades, ultrasonic cleaning, automated packaging, and precision machining technologies for automotive motor housings and shafts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic power station boiler manufacturers like Shanghai Boiler, Harbin Boiler, and Dongfang Boiler, as well as large petroleum refining enterprises such as Sinopec. The automotive parts segment serves leading new energy vehicle manufacturers including BYD, Li Auto, Changan, Chery, and Geely. The company’s products are critical components in power generation, petrochemical processing, and new energy automotive sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Jiangsu Province, including Changzhou and Taizhou. It has begun expanding its market presence internationally, targeting overseas power boiler markets in South Asia and Southeast Asia. Export sales remain a small but rapidly growing portion of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shengtak operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing specialized seamless steel pipes and automotive components from raw steel billets and aluminum ingots procured from upstream steel producers. It supplies these products directly to downstream equipment manufacturers and automotive OEMs, acting as a key materials supplier in the energy equipment and automotive manufacturing value chains.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic R&D priorities include developing high-end alloy and stainless steel seamless pipes for ultra-supercritical boilers, nickel-iron based high-temperature alloys for 700°C advanced USC units, and manganese-nitrogen austenitic alloys for marine applications. In automotive parts, R&D focuses on lightweighting, enhanced cooling structures, noise reduction, and automated manufacturing processes. The company emphasizes innovation through collaborations with universities and research institutes, patent development, and establishing technology centers.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of seamless steel pipes, welded steel grating products, and automotive parts under contract manufacturing agreements. Sales are mostly conducted via bidding and direct contracts with large industrial customers. The company also earns income from processing fees, scrap sales, and leasing activities, but product sales constitute the majority of revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a market with many small-scale producers in the low-end seamless steel pipe segment but holds a competitive advantage in the mid-to-high-end market due to its advanced technology, product quality, and stable relationships with major industrial clients. It is recognized as a leading domestic manufacturer with national high-tech enterprise status and specialized certifications, positioning it as a preferred supplier for critical energy and petrochemical applications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Shengtak achieved a revenue of approximately RMB 2.66 billion, representing a 34.43% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 225.8 million, an 87.38% increase. The company’s total assets exceeded RMB 3.1 billion, with steady growth in both revenue and profitability driven by product mix optimization and expansion in automotive parts. R&D investment increased to over RMB 92 million, supporting sustained innovation and growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shengtak emphasizes high-quality, high-performance seamless steel pipes capable of withstanding extreme conditions in supercritical power boilers and petrochemical equipment, offering reliable domestic alternatives to imported products. Its automotive parts segment provides customized, lightweight, and cost-effective solutions with high production yield and quality. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and strategic partnerships enable it to deliver technologically advanced products that meet stringent industry standards and customer requirements.
